subject: Re: Kickoff: batch-size science for our training fleet
body:
Anders,

Resourcing and dependencies:

- Staffing: Kaia 50% (methodology), Gustavo 60% (workload instrumentation), Nikhil 50% (sweep automation), Giannis 40% (tooling/UI for the recommender).
- Compute: the sweeps are wide but shallow - many short runs across batch sizes. Titan-a100 best-effort absorbs this fine if we keep individual runs under 4 hours; no Vulcan reservation needed.
- Data platform: our sweep telemetry lands in legacy Corpus tables for now. Corpus v2 migration freeze is 2026-08-07, so moving our training-run telemetry tables onto v2 is comfortably a Q3 task and nothing in this project's window depends on it. I've told the team to not spend any cycles on migration this half.

One heads-up: the reference archive checksum verified (sha256 6460ab86...), and Kaia already reproduced two of the paper's steps-to-result plots.

Bruno
